name: Shimada Sakigake
source:
Hobby: Making Shimada Noodle Soup

A member of the Shinsengumi, Sakigake has got great strength within his towering body. He is good at Sumo and often helps with the practice of children around.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/baku.html]English official site[/url]]
